## Declarations and implementations

```plato
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RGB_color_spaces
type Color
    implements ICoordinate
{
    R: Number;
    G: Number;
    B: Number;
    A: Number;
}

type ByteRGB
    implements ICoordinate
{
    R: Integer;
    G: Integer;
    B: Integer;
}

type ByteRGBA
    implements ICoordinate
{
    R: Integer;
    G: Integer;
    B: Integer;
    A: Integer;
}

// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CIELUV
type ColorLUV
    implements ICoordinate
{
    Lightness: Number;
    U: Number;
    V: Number;
}

// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CIELAB_color_space
type ColorLAB
    implements ICoordinate
{
    Lightness: Number;
    A: Number; 
    B: Number;
}

// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CIELAB_color_space#Cylindrical_model
type ColorLCh
    implements ICoordinate
{
    Lightness: Number;
    ChromaHue: PolarCoordinate;
}

// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV
type ColorHSV
    implements ICoordinate
{
    Hue: Angle;
    S: Number;
    V: Number;
}

// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV
type ColorHSL
    implements ICoordinate
{
    Hue: Angle;
    Saturation: Number;
    Luminance: Number;
}

// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YCbCr   
type ColorYCbCr
    implements ICoordinate
{
    Y: Number;
    Cb: Number;
    Cr: Number;
}
```
